title: Return a list safely
summary: Django: Return a list safely. Add a third title.
introduction: JsonResponse normally expects a dictionary. A dictionary can hold a list under a clear key. Open GET /books/.
learningObjectives: Return a list safely with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Return a list safely

blocks.text: The outer dictionary stores a list under books. JsonResponse preserves the two title values.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A named wrapper leaves room for more response information later.

seo.title: Django: Return a list safely
